subject: Re: Kickoff: diffusion concept decomposition & bias audits
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Giannis Sato leads at 50%, Farah Haddad 40% on the pipeline and infra, Katya Silva 30% on the audit methodology.

Compute, two phases: development runs on titan-a100 best-effort (16 GPUs — per-concept pseudo-token optimization is cheap individually). For the final sweep we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01, 256 accelerators, confirmed through Ines' reservation process — that week covers the full concept vocabulary at multiple sparsity levels, which is what the bias-audit claims need for launch review.

Note the timing is deliberate: vulcan's maintenance window is 6/22-6/24 and our LRB is 6/15, so the 6/1 week is effectively our only shot at scale. No slack behind it.

Deshawn
